notes.title: New version 1.710.25 has been released
notes.content:
An update to Star Story: The Horizon Escape (ver.1.710.25) has been released.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/f5a0108f3715291f4d73d85ff9f3622bfc27f71f.jpg[/img] 
The update will be applied automatically when you restart Star Story. 
The major changes include:
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem with getting for some Steam achievements
[*] Update to English and Russian localization files
[*] Scenes in desert performance are optimized  
[/list]

Best regards,
EvilCoGames Team

notes.title: Update version 1.709.22 is available
notes.content:
Due to players Evil Corporation Games continues to collect and fix some bugs in the game and release the new update version № 1.709.22
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/00e5211fe0df4a847efb4ba5670e5dbc4986736e.jpg[/img]
What’s new:
[list]
[*] The game continues after the opening of the "Golden Ending" before the other ones
[*] A bug with stun overlapping each other the wrong way is fixed
[*]  A bug with saving game settings is fixed
[*]  Black background appearance in the location of Mad Dream is fixed
[*]  Improved graphical support for the dialogue at the end of the Fuel The Revolution’ chapter
[/list]


Best regards,
EvilCoGames Team

notes.title: Update version 1.709.11 is available
notes.content:
Dear friends! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/48e4a7e4d3182ec77545ddfaed6f44bae49a0f96.jpg[/img]

Foremost we would like to thank all our friends in Steam, everybody, who has played our game, who helped us to make it better and posted some comments and recommendations. It’s really REALLY important to us, as we are working on our first project!

Based on the first week after the release feedback and results, we are launching the first official update of [b]Star Story: The Horizon Escape[/b] and introduce v.1.709.11!

What’s new:
[list]
[*]A large update to English and Russian localisation files. Typos, stylistics, grammar - all got a big fix.
[*]A major bug in the ending scene (the game could freeze) identified and fixed.
[*]Weapons reload interface improved for better usability.
[/list]
Sincerely yours,
EvilCoGamesTeam

notes.title: ✧The final countdown to full release \ (•◡•) /
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/1c9a588cc8add75ce5d6eb72e101fd7b09960e58.jpg[/img]
Dear friends! 
It has been a long time since we released the [b]Star Story: The Horizon Escape on Steam[/b].
We are ready to announce the exact release date of the fully complete, revised and improved (from standpoint, at least :) version of the game, out of early access.
It will be available to all players on Steam on [b]September 5, 2017[/b]!
Working on the update, we carefully considered all the comments and suggestions that we received.
[list]
    [*]We put great emphasis on the extension of the content in the game. We have revamped the world of Horizon, deepened character backgrounds and completely rewritten the story, while staying true to the original motives - now it's non-linear and have 24 (!!!!) alternative endings.
    [*]For the new version, many new worlds were created by our artists, the graphics of existing locations were detailed and extended with new unique events.
    [*]The event generation system was rebuilt by our dev. team to provide much more varied gameplay. Now it’s much less predictable and obvious than in the early access version.
[/list]
In a word, our team has invested a lot of work, love and desire to finish the complete version of the project, which we called Star Story: The Horizon Escape!
Sincerely, we hope that when you play our game, you will have as much fun as we got while we were developing it. 
 ✧ So, do not forget, on September 5th - the full release of Star Story: The Horizon Escape! ✧

notes.title: Steam Achievements and more
notes.content:
Hello!
Star Story: The Horizon Escape has [b]achievements[/b] now! There are currently 17 of them. Will you collect them all?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28342771/e0549f2270450078f1be0abdc518c33c275fa624.png[/img]

We’ve also made some improvements at this week.
[list]
    [*]fixed some localization problems (like incorrect language strings);
    [*]you don’t lose character’s shields and armor when you go to base and then return back to the overworld;
    [*]in some cases it was possible to lose some characteristics ‘Goodwill’, ‘Insight’, ‘Resolve’. Now they will be saved. For you. Forever.
[/list]


P.S. Thanks for all your feedback! It helps us to make the game better.
